AV5.age_study records (project and av5 site): the per-request "true age" and error metrics are INVALID - they were derived from docker log write timestamps, and FreeRADIUS stdout reaches docker in buffered bursts (an av5 row showed a computed 96 ms against a "true" 247.6 ms, impossible for a formula that cannot under-estimate by that amount). Valid from those runs: 161/161 Access-Accept on each site and 0 negative ages. The deterministic evidence for the proposed formula is AV5.probe; the frequency evidence is the host clock measurement and the FreeRADIUS age-assignment count.

owner-review/WP8/evidence/h1-feasibility/H1B_FEASIBILITY_REPORT.md section 8 said that under H1-A "MAC login is unchanged" because a lower-case stored MAC is already refused. The controlled H1.mac_compare runs (site pre vs site project) show that this holds only for mac-auth-mode=mac-as-username-and-password (CHAP password mismatch in both). With mac-auth-mode=mac-as-username, a lower-case stored MAC is ACCEPTED by the baseline and REFUSED by H1-A (nuxr-hotspot=reject:spelling): a NEW refusal caused by H1-A. The report text is kept unchanged; this record and the H1-A report correct it.
